import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# double gsl_ran_exponential_pdf(const double x, const double mu);
gsl.gsl_ran_exponential_pdf.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_ran_exponential_pdf.restype = ctypes.c_double

def exponential_pdf(x, mu):
    """Compute the PDF of an exponential distribution using GSL."""
    return gsl.gsl_ran_exponential_pdf(x, mu)

def assert_test():
    """Test cases for exponential_pdf function."""
    # Test with x = 0, mu = 1
    assert abs(exponential_pdf(0, 1) - 1.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed"
    # Test with x = 1, mu = 1
    assert abs(exponential_pdf(1, 1) - 0.36787944117144233) < 1e-9, "Test case 2 failed"
    # Test with x = 2, mu = 2
    assert abs(exponential_pdf(2, 2) - 0.18393972058572117) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed"
    # Test with x = -1, mu = 1 (should return 0)
    assert exponential_pdf(-1, 1) == 0, "Test case 4 failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
